using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Text.Json.Nodes;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Cthangover.Core.Bootstrap;
using Cthangover.Core.Games;
using Cthangover.Core.Mods.HotReload;
using Cthangover.Core.Settings;
using Cthangover.Mods.Actor3d;
using Cthangover.Mods.Navigation3d;
using Cthangover.Mods.Scene3d;
using Godot;

public sealed class ReloadProbeCommand : IModDevelopmentCommand
{
    private const string Actor = "proto_land_actor";
    private const string Slot = "__p0_replay";
    private const int Revision = 1;

    public IReadOnlyCollection<string> Commands { get; } = new[] { "inspect", "checkpoint", "restore", "measure-idle", "shore-cancel", "finish" };

    public async Task<JsonNode> ExecuteAsync(ModDevelopmentContext context, string command, CancellationToken token)
    {
        if (command == "finish")
        {
            ApplicationExit.Quit(context.Tree, 0);
            return new JsonObject();
        }

        if (command == "restore")
        {
            if (!GameSession.LoadAndEnter(context.Tree.Root.GetNode("SceneManager"), Slot))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("The replay checkpoint could not be restored.");
            context.MarkChanged();
            return new JsonObject();
        }

        if (Scene3dHost.Current?.Error is { } error)
            throw new InvalidOperationException(error);

        var actor = Actor3dSession.Current?.Find(Actor);
        if (actor?.Host?.Ready != true || !actor.IsOnFloor())
            return new JsonObject { ["ready"] = false, ["actor_exists"] = actor != null, ["location_ready"] = actor?.Host?.Ready };

        if (command == "checkpoint")
        {
            SaveService.Save("p0_manual");
            SaveService.Save(Slot, rememberSession: false);
            context.MarkChanged();
        }

        if (command == "shore-cancel")
        {
            var result = await CancelAtShore(actor, context.Tree, token);
            context.MarkChanged();
            return result;
        }

        var visual = actor.Presentation.Visual;
        if (command == "measure-idle")
        {
            var clock = visual.Animation.Clock;
            if (clock.Role != "idle")
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Expected the live idle role, found " + clock.Role);
            var before = clock.Position;
            visual.Advance(.1);
            context.MarkChanged();
            return new JsonObject { ["speed"] = (clock.Position - before) / .1 };
        }

        var dock = actor.Host.LocalNode("ogn_dock");
        var collision = dock.FindChild("ImportCollision", true, false);
        var path = Navigation3dRuntime.Current?.Query(actor.Host, Actor, actor.GlobalPosition,
            actor.GlobalPosition + Vector3.Right * 2, null, 1);
        var offset = context.Request["patched"]?.GetValue<bool>() == true
            ? visual.Socket("p0_probe").Position.X : 0;
        return new JsonObject
        {
            ["ready"] = true,
            ["revision"] = Revision,
            ["host"] = actor.Host.GetInstanceId(),
            ["body"] = actor.GetInstanceId(),
            ["collider"] = actor.GetNode<CollisionShape3D>("Capsule").Shape.GetInstanceId(),
            ["dock_collision"] = collision?.GetInstanceId(),
            ["dock_position"] = Vector(dock.GlobalPosition),
            ["model"] = visual.Model.GetInstanceId(),
            ["animation"] = visual.Animation.GetInstanceId(),
            ["action"] = visual.Animation.Clock.ActionId,
            ["position"] = Vector(actor.GlobalPosition),
            ["radius"] = actor.EffectiveActionProfile.Radius,
            ["socket_x"] = offset,
            ["lod"] = visual.LodId,
            ["nav_status"] = path?.Status,
            ["nav_points"] = path?.Points.Length
        };
    }

    private static async Task<JsonObject> CancelAtShore(Actor3dBody actor, SceneTree tree, CancellationToken token)
    {
        var site = new Vector3(-4.57659f, 0, -30.648985f);
        using var query = PhysicsRayQueryParameters3D.Create(site + Vector3.Up * 2, site + Vector3.Down * 2,
            actor.CollisionMask, new Godot.Collections.Array<Rid> { actor.GetRid() });
        using var hit = actor.GetWorld3D().DirectSpaceState.IntersectRay(query);
        if (hit.Count == 0)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("The reported shore position has no physical floor.");

        var floor = hit["position"].AsVector3();
        var ground = (hit["collider"].AsGodotObject() as Node)?.GetPath().ToString();
        actor.UseInput = false;
        actor.Drive(Vector2.Zero);
        actor.GlobalPosition = floor + Vector3.Up * .04f;
        actor.Velocity = Vector3.Zero;
        if (!actor.Traversal.TryLink("p0/shore_grab"))
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot stage test grab: " + actor.Traversal.Reason);

        var capsule = actor.EffectiveActionProfile;
        var gap = capsule.Centre[1] - capsule.Height * .5f;
        actor.GlobalPosition = floor + Vector3.Up * (.04f - gap);
        var before = actor.GlobalPosition.Y;
        actor.Drive(Vector2.Zero, jump: true);
        var end = actor.FixedSteps + 24;
        while (actor.FixedSteps < end)
        {
            token.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
            await tree.ToSignal(tree, SceneTree.SignalName.PhysicsFrame);
        }

        return new JsonObject
        {
            ["ground"] = ground,
            ["floor"] = floor.Y,
            ["before"] = before,
            ["after"] = actor.GlobalPosition.Y,
            ["on_floor"] = actor.IsOnFloor(),
            ["standing"] = Math.Abs(actor.EffectiveActionProfile.Height - actor.Definition.Height) < .001f,
            ["released"] = actor.Activity == null && actor.ActionControl == null,
            ["mode"] = actor.Traversal.Mode.ToString()
        };
    }

    private static JsonArray Vector(Vector3 value) => new(value.X, value.Y, value.Z);
}
